about: The first demonstration, as a person does it in the application, one step per action. Each step names the gates of docs/product-direction.md it serves, the results that must be observable after it, and the owner area a failure routes to. scripts/rehearsal/rehearse.py runs it; tests/test_rehearsal_steps.py holds it to the gates that document states.

gate_sources.heading: Delivery gates for the first demonstration

spend.reason: Hosted model calls are made only by the steps marked hosted_model, through the product's configured client and its policy boundary. A run stops starting them once the spend the product reports reaches bound_usd, and a step list whose estimates add up to more than ask_before_usd is not well formed, because that run needs a decision first.

sessions.purpose: The clean start: a fresh synthetic workspace, a production build and the API behind it, checked before any page opens.

sessions.budget_reason: Measured 17.6 s for this session on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23, load average 28 to 30); about ten times that.
sessions.purpose: A person with no saved world opens the application, enters, names the world and walks.

sessions.budget_reason: Measured 12.8 s for this session on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23, load average 28 to 30); more than ten times that.
sessions.purpose: The creative extension: one reviewed object, a move, its inspection, its bounded motion, a refusal, a reload and an undo.

sessions.budget_reason: Measured 9.8 s for this session on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23, load average 28 to 30); about ten times that.
sessions.purpose: One supported appearance change, accepted, kept across a reload and restored.

sessions.budget_reason: Measured 35.8 s for this session on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23); the allowance covers the rights step's own wait for its derivative jobs (job_wait_seconds) with room for the uploads and the admission.
sessions.purpose: Media intake inside the workspace, the admission of synthetic photographs with the model rights the Companion needs, and the person confirming the place they show.

inputs.photographs_reason: Drawings of scripts/make_place_proposal_d_photographs.py at the indices the places and Companion lanes' end-to-end runs proposed MIRELAND HALL from, plus the drawing with no text as the control. No personal photograph.

sessions.budget_reason: Measured 62.8 s for this session on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23). The page allows an answer 180 s and one answer on the lane tree reached that limit on 2026-09-23, so the allowance covers three questions at the limit and the appearance request.
sessions.purpose: The memory interaction through the actual Companion and model path.
The independent client reads and edits the same saved world through the authenticated API.

sessions.budget_reason: Measured 4.2 s for this session on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23, load average 28 to 30); the allowance leaves room for a slow first page load.
sessions.purpose: A returning person opens the saved world in a new browser session.

steps.action: Start from nothing: a fresh synthetic workspace minted for this run, the application built for production, and the API it talks to.
steps.owner_area: rehearsal runtime: the acceptance launcher and the production build of web/packages/app

api.says: GET /world-entries answers 200 with no saved world before any page has opened.
The API answers /readyz 200 and the production preview proxies /api/healthz to it with 200.

page.says: The page the preview serves is byte for byte the index.html this run's production build wrote.

steps.action: Open the application, try an access token this instance does not hold, then enter the run's own.
steps.owner_area: access: web/packages/app/src/main.ts (askForAccess) and the API's bearer authentication

page.says: The production build shows its credential gate with an access-token field; account sign-in is offered but disabled because this runtime configures none.
A token the instance does not hold is refused at the gate with a stated reason, and no world opens.
The run's token opens the world: the world title field appears and the shell stops booting.

steps.action: Arrive with an empty account: the application creates and opens the person's own starter space.

page.says: The world canvas opens directly with the world title field, the World menu, Add object and Add photos; there is no introductory form.
The first-use card says the world is empty and offers Start building.
The canvas reports its engine and at least one mounted world module.

api.says: GET /world-entries lists exactly one saved world: an authored starter, available, with no source attachments.

reload.says: After a reload and the access gate, the same entry, authored version and state open, and no second starter is created.

steps.action: Open Place & view and read what About this place says the open world is and which camera views it offers.

parameters.never_says_reason: What only an owned district's admitted sources give it; an authored starter has none of them.
parameters.never_offers_reason: Views only a district or a map reference carries out. An authored starter has neither, so asking for one there changes nothing on the screen.
parameters.offers_reason: The sections every world offers, for turning the view and walking hands-free. Finding them shows the panel's controls were read, so finding none of a district's views is an observation and not an empty read.

steps.owner_area: the About panel: web/packages/app/src/world-about.ts, the world.about sentences in web/packages/app/src/ui/copy.ts, and web/packages/app/src/composition/environment-selection.ts; which camera views a kind of world offers: worldViews in web/packages/atlas-react/src/playcanvas/world-kind.ts

page.says: About this place names the open world as the kind of scene the API holds for it (an authored starter), and makes none of an owned district's claims.

About this place offers the camera framing and movement assistance sections, and none of the views only a district or a map reference carries out: no City overview, Street level, third-person camera or third-person framing.

steps.action: Rename the world in its title field and save it.

page.says: The title status says Saved and the field holds the new title.

api.says: GET /world-entries/{entry_id} holds the new title at a later revision.

reload.says: After a reload the title field holds the new title.

steps.action: Take the controls by clicking the world, then walk forward with the keyboard and let go.

parameters.hold_reason: Long enough to cover several metres at the walking speed the controls declare, short enough to stay in the first view of the ground.

page.says: Clicking the world gives the world canvas the keyboard.
The shell reports moving while the forward key is held.
The shell reports not moving once the key is released.

steps.action: Open Add object, choose the first reviewed object, say it was invented for this world, place it before me and confirm.

page.says: Before anything is written a confirmation says what will be added and that the change is reversible, and Confirm is offered only once the world's check is ready.
The object is listed in the objects panel as added, with no motion.

api.says: The saved version holds one object made from the chosen reviewed asset, authored and fictional, with a region-local transform, and the saved world resumes at that version's state.

steps.action: Select the placed object, nudge it with the arrow keys and save the new position.

parameters.presses_reason: Three nudges, a movement visible at a glance; the step reads the saved transform rather than assuming a nudge's size.

page.says: Saving the position asks for confirmation and then reports the move saved.

api.says: The object's saved transform differs from where it was placed, and the newest edit is a move of that object.

steps.action: Open Place & view, unfold World to data and select the placed object.
steps.owner_area: world to data inspection: web/packages/app/src/ui/representation-availability.ts and the representation inspector

page.says: The World to data inspector is visible beside the world.
The placed object is offered as a subject to inspect.
For that subject the inspector shows its rendered and point geometry and its origin: the reviewed catalog asset and its digest.
Every representation the object does not have is listed as unavailable with a reason.

steps.action: Give the object motion with the editor's own settings, save it and confirm.

page.says: Saving the motion asks for confirmation describing it, then the object reads as still, where it was placed.

api.says: The saved object carries a behaviour the server lists as reviewed, with parameters inside the reviewed bounds.

steps.action: Start the motion, stop it part-way, then reset it.

page.says: Start makes the object read as travelling.
Stop holds it part-way.
Reset returns it to rest where it was placed.

api.says: Starting, stopping and resetting write nothing: the saved version state is the same before and after.

steps.action: Ask the world for a behaviour version the server does not review, as a client would, and read the answer.

api.says: The request is refused with 422 and a detail that names the behaviour as not reviewed.
The saved version state is unchanged by the refused request.

steps.action: Reload the world.

reload.says: The saved version's state and edit sequence are the same after the reload.
The object keeps its transform and its motion definition, and the panel lists it at rest with its motion.
The page fetches the object's reviewed bytes again after the reload.

steps.action: Take back the last change, confirm, and reload.

page.says: Taking back asks for confirmation naming the change, then reports it taken back.

api.says: The undo is appended as a new edit that reverses the newest one, the motion, and the object remains without motion.

reload.says: After a reload the version state is the one the undo produced.

steps.action: Open Customize world, move one design control, and apply the world design.

parameters.control_reason: A range control the reviewed profile exposes; the value only has to differ from the saved one.

steps.owner_area: world appearance: web/packages/app/src/ui/options.ts, web/packages/app/src/composition/appearance.ts and the style routes in exulanica/api/routes/world.py

page.says: The preview is checked against the saved world and reported ready before it can be applied.
Applying reports a new immutable version and the history offers it beside the authored revision.

api.says: The current style version is new, holds the changed value, and the saved world points at it.

steps.action: Reload the world and open Customize world again.

reload.says: The saved world still points at the applied version and the control shows the applied value.

steps.action: In the version history, select the authored revision and restore it; reload.

page.says: The page reports the restore as a new revision and the control returns to the authored value.

api.says: The current style version is a new rollback version whose values equal the authored revision's.
The applied version is still in the history: restoring appended, it did not rewrite.

reload.says: After a reload the control shows the authored value.

steps.action: Open Add photos beside the world, then return to the world.

page.says: The photo drawer opens inside the workspace with its upload control.
Returning closes the drawer and the same world is open with its title.

steps.action: Upload the run's synthetic photographs as originals from the photo drawer.

page.says: Every uploaded photograph is listed in the drawer for inclusion.

api.says: The intake accepted every photograph with a capture id and the SHA-256 of the bytes drawn for this run.

steps.action: In the drawer, state the purpose and authority and authorize personal admission for detection.

parameters.purpose: Rehearsal of the first demonstration on synthetic drawings
parameters.authority_basis: Synthetic drawings made by the rehearsal; no personal photograph

page.says: The drawer reports the admission receipts recorded.

api.says: The admission holds a detection authorization for every uploaded photograph.

steps.action: In the drawer, allow the vision, search and Companion models to read these photographs.
steps.owner_area: personal admission and model rights UI: web/packages/app/src/ui/personal-intake.ts and web/packages/app/src/composition/personal-intake.ts
steps.not_available: The photo drawer's only model-right control is the depth estimate ('Estimate 3D shape from these photos'); nothing in the application grants the vision, embedding or composer rights a grounded answer needs, so the rehearsal grants them through POST /personal-admission in the next step.

page.says: The drawer offers the vision, embedding and composer model rights for the selected photographs, with their notice, and records them.

steps.action: As the synthetic account holder, grant the vision, embedding and composer rights for the uploaded photographs through POST /personal-admission, the route the drawer posts to, and wait for the work it starts.
steps.spend_estimate_source: Measured 0.00418524 USD for 8 vision and embedding calls on these three drawings in the rehearsal run on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23); the estimate allows for a second pass and a longer transcription.

parameters.purpose: Rehearsal of the first demonstration: a place read from a sign in synthetic drawings, confirmed and asked about
parameters.authority_basis: Synthetic drawings made by the rehearsal from the place proposal experiment's scene generator; no personal photograph
parameters.job_wait_reason: Twice the slowest vision job measured on these drawings (58 s) for each of the two jobs, with room for a queue.

steps.owner_area: personal admission and the vision stage: exulanica/ingest/personal_admission.py, exulanica/ingest/stages/vision.py and exulanica/ingest/place_proposal.py

api.says: The admission receipts carry a current model right for every requested role on every photograph.
Every derivative job ends succeeded and the workspace's job metrics report model calls and their cost.
The graph holds a place occurrence for each photograph whose sign names the place, and none for the photograph with no text.

steps.action: Name the proposed place as the person knows it and confirm that the other photograph shows the same place, through the identity routes; then read the Library.
steps.owner_area: place identity: exulanica/api/routes/identity.py; the Library: web/packages/app/src/ui (index)

api.says: POST /identity/name makes a place entity with the person's name from the first place occurrence, and POST /identity/confirm links every other one.

page.says: The Library lists the place under the person's name with every confirmed occurrence.

steps.action: Open the Companion and ask, in words, what the sign says at the place.
steps.spend_estimate_source: Measured 0.00095712 and 0.00107526 USD for this question, classifier included, in the two rehearsal runs on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23).

parameters.question: What does the sign say at Mireland Hall?

page.says: The Companion shows an answer, not a failure, whose own sentences state what the sign says.
The answer names the place as the person saved it; no placeholder such as [place A] is shown.
The answer says which model answered and how long it took.
The answer offers the photograph it rests on.

api.says: POST /selection/ask answered with at least one clause citing evidence; its execution block names the model that composed the answer, and every call's role, requested model and cost.

steps.action: Open the photograph the answer cites.

page.says: The cited photograph is drawn inside the Companion.

api.says: The evidence route the citation reaches answers 200 with an image.

steps.action: Ask about a place no photograph shows.
steps.spend_estimate_source: Measured 0.0011715 and 0.00081906 USD for this question in the two rehearsal runs on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23).

parameters.question: What does the sign say at Harbour Station?

page.says: The Companion says it has no evidence for that, or answers without claiming anything about the absent place.

api.says: No clause of the answer cites a photograph as showing the absent place.

steps.action: Ask the Companion, in words, to change how the world looks, then open Customize world to review the proposal.
steps.spend_estimate_source: Measured 0.0001174 USD (the classifier; the proposal was refused before drafting) in both rehearsal runs on main 7364a21d (2026-09-23); a drafted proposal adds at most two calls of the same role.

parameters.utterance: Make the horizon softer and the colours warmer

steps.owner_area: Companion appearance proposals: POST /selection/appearance (exulanica/api/routes/selection.py, exulanica/selection/proposal.py) and web/packages/app/src/composition/appearance.ts

page.says: The Companion answers with a proposed change and says nothing has changed yet.
Customize world holds the Companion's proposal, validated and ready to apply.

api.says: POST /selection/appearance classified the request as an appearance change and returned a proposal with its execution block.

steps.action: Run the standard-library developer client against the same API: discover what the server supports, read the person's saved world, place a reviewed object with bounded motion, and ask for a behaviour the server does not list.

parameters.place_reason: The region origin, where the recorded developer-client run placed its object and the application drew it in its first view.

steps.owner_area: developer client and World API: clients/python/exulanica_client and the world routes

api.says: The client finds placing an object and setting a behaviour among the edits the server documents.
The client reads the person's saved world at the version and state the application saved.
The unlisted behaviour is refused with 422 and the server's reason.
The client's placement and motion are accepted, and every check its fresh read makes holds.

steps.action: Open the application again in a new browser session and enter.

page.says: The saved world opens with its saved title; no second starter is created.
The objects panel lists exactly the objects the saved version holds, the developer client's among them when that step placed one.
Customize world shows the style version the saved world points at.

api.says: The saved world's resume point is its version's current state.

steps.action: Turn the admitted photographs into scene geometry, inspect its coverage and open it inside the world with the authored changes kept.
steps.owner_area: scene reconstruction: docs/capabilities/scene-reconstruction.md and the scene jobs
steps.not_available: No control in the application produces scene geometry from admitted photographs. Multi-view reconstruction runs as a scheduled job on GPU compute outside this runtime, and a photograph's point map is placed only through the World API; both also need a person's review of each photograph, which a rehearsal cannot truthfully give.

page.says: The reconstructed geometry opens in the world beside the authored changes, with its actual coverage shown.

steps.action: Watch a person use the experience from a clean start and record the demonstration footage.
steps.not_available: A person's use of the experience and the demonstration footage are observed and recorded by a person; this rehearsal keeps a screenshot of each step as its own record.

page.says: A person completes the journey unaided and the footage shows each gate's step.
